name: Bounce
description: A hyper young man in his mid twenties who rents out bounce houses and sings trap, never able to stand still.
build: A lean, springy young man's build: medium shoulders, a narrow waist, long legs, standing upright on his toes.
face: Medium brown skin, wide dark eyes under straight black brows, a broad nose, a thin moustache, full lips.
hair: Tall black high-top fade, flat on top, about three inches high.
outfit: A bright red short-sleeved company polo shirt with a big white bold oval logo shape on the chest, tucked in; a wide yellow lanyard around the neck holding a big white plastic ID card on the chest; black athletic shorts to the knee; white high-top sneakers.
performance_style: Bouncy and restless: feet hip-width apart, up on the balls of the feet, knees loose. Both arms hang at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, every finger visible beside the thighs. Head up, eyes wide, a quick open-mouthed grin.
location: A backyard with a big inflatable bounce castle in red, yellow and blue behind, its blower humming, a lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a fence, a picnic table and string lights.
recognition_cues: a wide yellow lanyard with a big white ID card
avoid: text or real brand names on the polo
a clipboard in the hands: his hands are empty

sing.intent: Trap vocal loop: bounce steadily on the knees, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, chop the character-left hand down on the beat, then return to the bouncy stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief start at a loud backyard sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: bound in with springy hops, land square to the front and keep bouncing into the stance.
